key.name: toggle
key.description: Keybinding that toggles the spotlight on and off

key.name: hold
key.description: Keybinding that shows the spotlight only while held. Requires GNOME Shell 48+. Empty disables it

key.name: toggle-zoom
key.description: Keybinding that toggles zoom mode while spotlight is active

key.name: dim-opacity
key.description: Darkness of the overlay in percent (0 = transparent, 100 = fully black)

key.name: focus-radius
key.description: Radius of the circular undimmed spotlight area in pixels

key.name: edge-softness
key.description: Soft transition width at the spotlight edge in pixels

key.name: zoom-factor
key.description: Zoom multiplier (1.0 = no zoom, 2.0 = double size)
